Class NativeWritableRaster

java.lang.Object
java.awt.image.Raster
java.awt.image.WritableRaster
icyllis.arc3d.core.image.NativeWritableRaster
public class NativeWritableRaster extends WritableRaster
A writable raster that writes data directly into off-heap memory.

Note: not all Java2D methods are compatible with a custom WritableRaster, since they can cast to known subclass to steal the heap array. Therefore, this class should only be used where compatibility is known.

This class does not manage the memory, caller should ensure the address is valid while this and child object is reachable.

This class provides faster memory copy when the heap data layout matches the native data layout (continuous).
